errors.evidence: The x-axis scale runs from 0 to 0.9, which are dimensionless numbers. The unit 'Eurocent/kWh' is part of the axis label, not the scale values themselves.
The light gray line representing 'Durchschnittliches Brutto-Gebot Gewinner' is a solid line, not a dashed (gestrichelte) line.
The light gray line does not rise continuously from the start. It is flat from a bonus level of 0 to 0.2, and only begins to rise after 0.2.

errors.text_span: erreicht bei 0,4 Eurocent/kWh etwa 5,35 Eurocent/kWh, um danach bis 0,9 Eurocent/kWh auf etwa 5,38 Eurocent/kWh leicht anzusteigen
errors.evidence: The light gray line reaches a value of exactly 5.4 Eurocent/kWh at a bonus level of 0.4, and then remains perfectly flat at 5.4 until 0.9. The description incorrectly states the value is ~5.35 and that it continues to rise.
The dark gray line is only stable until a bonus level of 0.2. After 0.2, it begins to decrease.
The dark gray line ends at exactly 4.5 Eurocent/kWh at a bonus level of 0.9, which is clearly marked by a grid line. The value 4.45 is an inaccurate approximation.
The purple line is only stable until a bonus level of 0.2. After 0.2, it begins to rise.

errors.text_span: bleibt bis 0,9 Eurocent/kWh auf etwa 5,23 Eurocent/kWh konstant
errors.evidence: The purple line remains constant at a value of 5.25 Eurocent/kWh from a bonus level of 0.4 to 0.9, not 5.23 Eurocent/kWh.
